subject: English
question_text: Suppose, You are Muhib. Write a latter to your friend
stimulus: Monir about the importance of learning English. 10
guide_solution: Letter writing 34/1, Protapdas Lane Banglabazar, Dhaka Dear Monir, My love to you. Hope, you are well. However, I am sorry to know that you are not interested to learn English. But English has been the key to success in the present world. Now I am telling you about the necessity of learning English.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 113 — Kazirchar Secondary School, Barisal
